def configure_lmps(self, lmps: dict[str, LMP]) -> None:
        super().configure_lmps(lmps)
        (self.output / "finger-source.txt").write_text(Path(__file__).read_text())
        with (self.output / "hand-interface-prompt.txt").open("a") as stream:
            stream.write("\n" + FINGER_CONTEXT + "\n")
        for lmp in lmps.values():
            lmp._variable_vars["set_hand_joint_targets"] = self.set_hand_joint_targets
            lmp._base_prompt += "\n\n" + FINGER_CONTEXT
